headline: Sony kills PlayStation disc production ending physical game production in 2028
summary: Sony to stop producing PlayStation game discs in January 2028. Games will only be available digitally.
details: Sony has announced that it will stop producing PlayStation game discs starting in January 2028. This move marks the end of physical media in cutting-edge gaming.

The decision is in response to shifting trends in consumer preference, with 85% of PlayStation games purchased digitally in Q4 2025. The PlayStation Store on PS3 and PS Vita systems will also be shut down.

The move does not affect backward compatibility, and rumors suggest the PlayStation 6 may have an optional disc drive for playing old games. Sony's decision to end physical game production has been expected due to declining Blu-ray drive production and the rise of digital game purchases.
caption:
Physical PlayStation game discs will no longer be produced after January 2028. What does this mean for gamers?

Sony has announced that it will stop producing PlayStation game discs starting in January 2028. This move marks the end of physical media in cutting-edge gaming.

The decision is in response to shifting trends in consumer preference, with 85% of PlayStation games purchased digitally in Q4 2025. The PlayStation Store on PS3 and PS Vita systems will also be shut down.

The move does not affect backward compatibility, and rumors suggest the PlayStation 6 may have an optional disc drive for playing old games. Sony's decision to end physical game production has been expected due to declining Blu-ray drive production and the rise of digital game purchases.

#Gaming #PlayStation #Sony #DigitalGames

Source: Tom's Hardware
